clippings.speaker: Ron Clements
clippings.quote: I’m more of a big picture guy. John’s more of a detail guy,
clippings.title: Interview: Ron Clements on the Magic Behind Disney Animation and the Stories Audiences Take to Heart
clippings.context: Clements, in a conversation with Laughing Place about his memoir, on how he and Musker divide their work.

clippings.speaker: John Musker
clippings.quote: And then they gave it a reprieve when they read the two-page treatment Ron wrote.
clippings.title: Directors John Musker and Ron Clements on Creating the World of 'Moana' — and How 'Little Mermaid' Almost Got Sunk
clippings.context: Musker, in a 2016 Yahoo Movies interview, recalling how Disney reversed its early rejection of The Little Mermaid after reading Clements's treatment.

clippings.speaker: John Musker
clippings.quote: It used to be in our system more so that we dealt one on one with the animators. We'd critique their animation, just he and I, look at the stuff and with maybe a supervisor.
clippings.title: Interview: The Princess And The Frog Directors Jon Musker And Ron Clements
clippings.context: Musker, in a 2009 round-table, on how he and Clements reviewed animators' work one-on-one before Pixar-style group dailies. "he" is Clements.
